title: GitHub artifact upload fails with ETIMEDOUT network timeout
error_pattern:

analysis: The 'Upload logs, and test results' step failed with a GitHub Actions artifact upload network timeout (ETIMEDOUT), a transient infrastructure issue unrelated to PR changes (which only touch package validation baseline version and CompatibilitySuppressions.xml).
failure_details:
**failure**: Failed to CreateArtifact: Unable to make request: ETIMEDOUT
If you are using self-hosted runners, please make sure your runner has access to all GitHub endpoints: https://docs.github.com/en/actions/hosting-your-own-runners/managing-self-hosted-runners/about-self-hosted-runners#communication-between-self-hosted-runners-and-github
